THE_ARCHITECT.talk.REED_CHARACTER_REED_C: The flame that brought me here still burns. I won't be turned away.
A mercenary who walks with fire. How... industrious. Do you truly believe your embers can scorch what I have built?
I don't just believe it. I'll show you.
Back again, little flame? Your persistence is... notable.
Persistence is all I've ever had. It's enough.
Then let us see how long it lasts.
Well, well! A mercenary with fire in her veins! Come, browse my wares — everything has a price.
I've dealt with merchants before. Show me what you have.
Ha! Direct and to the point! I like that in a customer!
Back again, fire-mercenary? The pile's been restocked. Take a look!
...one who walks with fire... you know... the cycle... as I do...
I don't know your cycle. I only know my mission.
...then go... find... the Architect... and end... what must... end...
A restless flame... sit, rest... let the embers settle...
I don't rest until the mission is done. But I'll take what you offer.
So driven... very well, take this...
The driven flame returns... rest a moment... then take what you need...
WHERE'S YOUR WEAPON?! A real fighter needs real steel!!
My fire is all the weapon I need.
FIGHTING WITH FIRE!! NO BLADE!! STRONG!! I LIKE IT!!
THE FIRE FIGHTER RETURNS!! STILL NO BLADE!! STILL STRONG!!
VAKUU.talk.REED_CHARACTER_REED_CHARACTER: A mercenary of fire and steel... I can offer you power far greater. Sign here.
I've seen enough contracts to know a bad deal when I see one. No.
A shame. The offer stands, should you change your mind.
Still clinging to your flames? The contract awaits...
OROBAS.talk.REED_CHARACTER_REED_CHARACTE: Ooh!! Fire!! So bright!! So shiny!! Take this shiny too!!
I'm not here for shinies. But I won't refuse what's offered.
Fire friend takes shiny!! Good!! More shiny for fire friend!!
Fire friend back!! Found more shiny!! You look you look!!
TEZCATARA.talk.REED_CHARACTER_REED_CHARA: Come closer, dear. My eyes aren't what they were, but I can feel that fire inside you.
I'll keep my distance, thanks. What are you offering?
Such a hot little flame. Let me stoke it for you, dear.
Back so soon, little ember? Come, let that fire breathe...
NONUPEIPE.talk.REED_CHARACTER_REED_CHARA: A pilgrim wreathed in flame! How splendid! Come, receive my blessing.
I'm no pilgrim. But I'll take what help I can get.
A warrior who knows what she needs! How refreshing! Take this, then.
The flame-warrior returns. Wear these gifts well, traveler.
